description: Check ALL 284 distinct URLs in column E for HTTP accessibility. Produce a report categorizing each URL as working (2xx/3xx response) or broken (4xx, 5xx, timeout, connection error, SSL error). Save the report as a JSON file for subsequent features to consume.
steps: Write a Python script that reads all 284 distinct URLs from column E of the Excel file
For each URL, make an HTTP HEAD request (falling back to GET if HEAD fails) with a 15-second timeout and a browser-like User-Agent header
Record the result: status code, final URL after redirects, or error type (timeout, connection refused, SSL error, DNS failure)
Categorize results: 'working' (2xx or 3xx), 'broken' (4xx, 5xx, or any error)
Save results to url_check_results.json with structure: {working: [...], broken: [{url, error_type, status_code, rows_affected}]}
Print summary: total checked, working count, broken count
Also identify which rows in the Excel map to each broken URL
acceptance_criteria: All 284 distinct URLs have been checked
Each broken URL entry includes the error type and the Excel row numbers that use it
